summary: No findings. tools/chart-print/main.ts takes no input (no argv, env, or file path); it imports the bundled SIX_MAX_CHART and writes formatChart() output to stdout. No shell, fs, network, or randomness. src/advice/chart-print.ts is a pure string formatter over validated chart data. The chart:print script reuses the existing tools/playtest/resolve-ts.js loader. SIX_MAX_CHART is still built by parseChart(sixMax) at import in src/advice/preflop.ts, and src/advice/preflop-chart.ts is unchanged, so the strict validator still fails closed (throws ChartValidationError). package.json changes only the scripts block; no dependency or lockfile changes. The revised six-max.json justifications read as original prose in the project's own voice: no URLs, author or book names, or copyright markers (REQ-061).
